opcode_22_dispatch.response_b8: WifiOTAPackageRsp (family m): Wi-Fi/OTA domain, cross-domain coincidence, never on the BLE transfer path
opcode_22_dispatch.discriminator: MECHANISM, not opcode: file-list/resume share NOTHING at dispatch — resume responses route via the q.E(c$c,[B) lambda bound by the q.a(J,I) registration (news c5), while file-list responses route via the q.a(s5,c$c,[B) lambda bound by the q.a(J,Z) registration (accumulates q2). The z dispatcher matches opcode {22} to outstanding registrations; each registration owns its parser. b8 is constructed only in w7 (Wi-Fi agent), unreachable from BLE registrations.
opcode_22_dispatch.verification: bootstrap method_attr 51/52 -> q.I/q.E impls (resume); facade resumeRecord literals; q2/s5 path for file-list (separate registration). Opcode alone is AMBIGUOUS across domains; within BLE, registration context disambiguates.
